g.text: OLED and manual transfer position feedback

g.desc: OLED and manual transfer position feedback

g.text: Main J32 mates with panel J1. The four-wire OLED cable plugs into panel J7. J36 carries the independent guard monitor and HOST / LOCAL feedback.

g.desc: Main J32 mates with panel J1. The four-wire OLED cable plugs into panel J7. J36 carries the independent guard monitor and HOST / LOCAL feedback.

g.text: J36.4 heartbeat and J36.5 panel permission feed the high-impedance, isolated guard inputs. Keep external power off J36.

g.desc: J36.4 heartbeat and J36.5 panel permission feed the high-impedance, isolated guard inputs. Keep external power off J36.

g.text: Separate internal low-voltage position contacts. HOST and LOCAL assert low. Both or neither means inhibit. No connection to field contact wiring.

g.desc: Separate internal low-voltage position contacts. HOST and LOCAL assert low. Both or neither means inhibit. No connection to field contact wiring.
